game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Ivy Tower, an ivy-covered tower: the spirit seeker must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform carved tiles.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ivy Tower: an ivy-covered tower
core_gameplay_loop: In Ivy Tower, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform carved tiles. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the sealed archway using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The sealed archway reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the sealed archway is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ivy Tower'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Ivy Tower.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sealed archway reached with actions_used <= 12.
